messages.content: The anniversary dinner has moved from Friday to Saturday at 7:30, same Old San Juan restaurant. Please update the trip record without touching our flights or five-night hotel booking.
I’ll leave the confirmed May 12-17 flights and Historic King room unchanged and move only the dinner entry to Saturday at 7:30 p.m. What is currently scheduled Saturday afternoon?
We have the guided excursion that is supposed to finish near the hotel around 5:15. Is that enough time to shower, change, and get to dinner?

Yes, provided 5:15 is the actual return time in Old San Juan. That leaves 2 hours 15 minutes. Allow about 15 minutes to get from the drop-off to your room, 75 minutes to get ready, and 15 minutes to walk to the restaurant, putting you there around 7:15.
The operator says the drop-off is Plaza Colón, not the hotel door. Does that change it much?

Only slightly. Plaza Colón should still be a short walk from the hotel, so I would treat 5:30 as the practical room-arrival time. You would still have 90 minutes to get ready and could leave at 7:05 for the roughly eight-minute walk, with a buffer before the reservation.
Good. Confirm we do not need a car from the hotel, and note what happens if the excursion runs late.

Updated record: Saturday excursion returns at Plaza Colón at approximately 5:15 p.m.; walk back to the confirmed Old San Juan hotel and target being in the room by 5:30. Get ready from 5:30 to 7:05, then walk to the same restaurant for the rescheduled 7:30 anniversary dinner. No car is needed from the hotel under the planned timing. If the excursion has not reached Plaza Colón by 5:45, contact the restaurant to advise of possible delay and take a taxi or rideshare directly to the hotel if the operator permits an earlier drop-off. The confirmed five-night hotel stay and both travelers’ flights remain unchanged.

No hotel-to-restaurant car is planned. If the excursion has not returned by 5:45, they will notify the restaurant and use a taxi or rideshare to the hotel if an earlier drop-off is possible. Sunday remains unchanged: check out at 11:00 a.m., collect stored bags around 1:15 p.m., leave near 1:30, and target SJU around 1:50 for the 3:55 p.m. flight.
